biotools.summary: diurnal.plant.tools is a database containing diurnal gene expression profiles from 17 members of the Archaeplastida lineage, expanded to include four agriculturally significant crop species and Marchantia. It facilitates cross-species comparisons to better understand the plant circadian clock.
